name: Tomato
description: A fruit native to the Americas that became a major ingredient in cuisines worldwide.

places.name: Andes Region
places.notes: Wild tomato relatives and early cultivation are associated with the Andes region.

places.name: Mesoamerica
places.notes: Tomatoes were cultivated and incorporated into local cuisines.

places.name: Spanish Empire
places.notes: Tomatoes were brought to Europe after Spanish contact with the Americas.

places.name: Italy
places.notes: Tomatoes became central to Italian cuisine, especially sauces.
